user.title: Sign in with Vatti account
user.description: Enter the phone number registered in the Vatti Smart Home app. A dedicated account shared with your water heater is recommended, otherwise the app and Home Assistant will sign each other out.

captcha.title: Complete the slider captcha

sms.title: Enter SMS code
sms.description: A verification code was sent to {phone}.

family.title: Select a family
family.description: This account has multiple families. Choose the one containing your water heater.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The login for {phone} has expired (probably signed out by the mobile app). Submit to run the captcha and SMS flow again; entities are kept.

error.invalid_ticket: The captcha ticket is invalid or expired, please retry the slider
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Vatti cloud, check your network

abort.reauth_failed: Re-authentication failed, remove and add the integration again
abort.http_unavailable: Home Assistant HTTP component is unavailable, cannot host the captcha page

error.cannot_connect: Could not load the family list; other options can still be saved

refresh.name: Refresh now
refresh.description: Fetch the latest state of all Vatti water heaters immediately.
